comparison.objective: Hold a spring-return safety loop released while operating a bottle-opening rocker.
comparison.physical_skill: Sustained bimanual contact against a torsion spring while pressing a separate control; no tool insertion, collar adjustment, or relocking.
comparison.success_condition: Bottle opens while the loop remains released; releasing the loop prevents success. Numeric loop/rocker details are only partly reported in the record.
comparison.reason: The candidate commissions damping through captive-screw tool access, collar tuning, and measured impact cycles; this record tests simultaneous spring restraint and bottle actuation.
